verdict.rationale: cubic documents a built-in AI assistant users can hand tasks to. In PR comments you can ask questions, trigger reviews and request fixes. 'Fix with cubic' generates a fix and pushes it to the PR branch, and an in-product chat answers questions about selected code or gives a guided 'tour this PR'. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the assistant's task delegation, delegable tasks beyond review, Q&A and fixes, and current (non-archived) docs for the chat sidebar.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Interact with cubic in PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews, and fix issues.
cubic generates the fix and pushes it to your PR branch.
cubic can automatically fix issues identified during code review. Request a targeted fix with one click.
Select code and choose **Add to AI chat** to ask about it with the diff and codebase as context.
Ask chat to "tour this PR" for a step-by-step review of the changes and what to check.
The chat sidebar helps you quickly understand and navigate your pull requests (PRs) with intelligent, context-aware assistance directly within cubic.
